arguments.analyst: Single-site observations dominate the recent evidence: N144Y (O6), I161L (O8), I188L (O9) and I136L:V163A (O10) all remain high, while only multi-mutation combinations (O4, O5) collapse. Hypothesis: conservative, surface/distal single or double substitutions preserve brightness, so pairing high-performing singleton edits from the menu should score near the top.
arguments.hypothesis: Combining individually tolerated edits (e.g. N144Y with N23S, or K156E-type neutral pairs) yields high brightness, whereas 3-4 mutation menus with buried hydrophobic swaps (e.g. C30, C32) degrade folding.

decision.analyst: Single-site observations dominate the recent evidence: N144Y (O6), I161L (O8), I188L (O9) and I136L:V163A (O10) all remain high, while only multi-mutation combinations (O4, O5) collapse. Hypothesis: conservative, surface/distal single or double substitutions preserve brightness, so pairing high-performing singleton edits from the menu should score near the top.
decision.hypothesis: Combining individually tolerated edits (e.g. N144Y with N23S, or K156E-type neutral pairs) yields high brightness, whereas 3-4 mutation menus with buried hydrophobic swaps (e.g. C30, C32) degrade folding.
decision.critic: C17/C22 share an identical fitted value, so one may be a redundant menu artifact; C30's high uncertainty and low estimate make it a weak control.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize highest fitted singletons C17/C22, then C12 and C44 pairing tolerated edits, and C30 to test the multi-mutation collapse predicted by O4/O5.
